# OSSLLMAPI — full site content

## Home (https://ossllmapi.vercel.app/)

**OSSLLMAPI: one OpenAI-compatible API for 1,313 free model endpoints**

OSSLLMAPI routes every request across 87 free LLM providers and 1,313 free model endpoints behind one OpenAI-compatible /v1 API — encrypted keys, per-key budgets, automatic failover. Free and open source.

### Hero

Free LLMs, one API. OSSLLMAPI puts the free tiers of 87 LLM providers — 1,313 model endpoints and 10.1 billion tokens a month — behind one OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint. You keep one key, one base URL and one bill of zero. Open source, MIT licensed, self-host it anywhere.

### Every request, routed and counted

The models list shows every endpoint the router can reach. The open item shows this month's usage: tokens spent per key, against the free-tier cap of each provider. Tokens this month: 7.4B of the 10.1B free tier, tracked per key against each cap.

### The router does the work

- **Picks the best model**: every request is routed to the fastest model that can serve it, chosen from your ordered fallback chain. This week: 62% of requests go to the first choice, 31% to the second, 7% to the fallback.
- **Falls over on rate limits**: when a provider throttles or hits its cap, the next provider takes the request before your caller ever sees it.
- **Keeps keys encrypted**: provider keys are encrypted at rest. Clients only ever see one unified key, minted in the dashboard.
- **Counts tokens per key**: usage is tracked per key against every provider's free-tier cap, so you never quietly pass a limit.

### One endpoint, every provider

The router holds the free tiers of 87 providers in one catalog and serves them through the same /v1 surface — chat, embeddings, images and audio. Endpoint families: /v1/chat/completions, /v1/embeddings, /v1/images/generations, /v1/audio, plus an MCP server. Every one OpenAI-compatible. Providers include OpenAI, Anthropic, Claude, Gemini, Ollama and others.

### Set it up in three steps

1. **Add a provider key** — open the dashboard, paste a key from any of the 87 providers; it is encrypted and stored in the vault.
2. **Call /v1** — point any OpenAI-compatible client at http://localhost:3001/v1 with the unified key. Existing SDK code runs unchanged.
3. **The router picks** — every request is routed to the best free model, with failover and per-key budgets tracked.

### Questions, answered

- **What is OSSLLMAPI?** A modified version of freellmapi made by Zelvior Labs. It aggregates the free tiers of 87 LLM providers — 1,313 free model endpoints and about 10.1 billion free tokens a month — behind one OpenAI-compatible /v1 API, with encrypted key storage, automatic failover and per-key usage tracking.
- **Is OSSLLMAPI free?** Yes. MIT-licensed and free to self-host. The free model catalog ships as a monthly signed snapshot; a premium subscription at ossllmapi.co delivers the live catalog the same day new models, quota changes and compatibility fixes land.
- **How do I call OSSLLMAPI?** Point any OpenAI-compatible client at http://localhost:3001/v1 with the unified key from the dashboard. Chat, embedding, image and audio requests all use the same base URL.
- **How does the router pick a model?** For every request the router picks the best available model from your fallback chain, then falls over to the next provider when one is rate-limited or over its free-tier cap, tracking token usage per key.
- **Which platforms does OSSLLMAPI run on?** Desktop apps for Windows, macOS and Linux, an Android APK, an iOS IPA, a Docker image for self-hosting, and a CLI. All downloadable from the GitHub releases page.
- **Are my provider keys safe?** Keys are stored encrypted at rest. The dashboard exposes a single unified API key, and per-key token budgets keep every provider under its free-tier cap.

### Get OSSLLMAPI

Free, MIT-licensed, yours to self-host. Desktop, mobile and container builds of the same router, all from one releases page (https://github.com/zelvior/ossllmapi/releases/latest): Windows desktop app, macOS desktop app (arm64 & x64), Linux desktop app (AppImage), Android APK, iOS IPA, Docker image (ghcr.io/ossllmapi). The CLI ships on npm as ossllmapi. Premium live catalog at ossllmapi.co ($19/yr, cancel anytime).

## Privacy (https://ossllmapi.vercel.app/privacy.html)

OSSLLMAPI is a self-hosted, open-source software project. This website does not run a tracking or analytics suite, does not set advertising cookies, and does not sell personal data. The site is hosted on Vercel, which may log standard hosting data (request timestamps, IP addresses, request paths) for security and reliability. If you self-host OSSLLMAPI, your provider keys are stored encrypted at rest and only a unified API key is exposed to clients. Contact: Zelvior Labs via the links on the home page.

## Terms (https://ossllmapi.vercel.app/terms.html)

OSSLLMAPI is free and open-source software released under the MIT License — a modified version of tashfeenahmed/freellmapi, made by Zelvior Labs. Use it as you like, within the MIT license terms. The premium live model catalog at ossllmapi.co is a paid subscription ($19/yr, cancel anytime) and is governed by its own checkout terms at purchase. The software is provided as-is, without warranty. Provider free tiers, model availability and quota caps are set by each provider and can change at any time.
